description: US producer price index for wood pulp (BLS series WPU0911, via FRED), monthly index value. This is a price index, not the RISI Northern Bleached Softwood Kraft (NBSK) benchmark; the route name is kept for the owner. Latest value plus up to 24 months of history. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
